William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

To H[ayley]: Thy friendship oft has made my heart to ache

VI
T
HY
 friendship oft has made my heart to ache:
Do be my enemy—for friendship’s sake.
